name: P2-upload-source
steps: (async()=>{const a=window.__p2app,h=window.__sim.host,task=h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id.endsWith('2001'));const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode('Reviewed source');const hash=[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes))].map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');const receipt=await a.session.command({command:'create_upload_reviewed',name:'source.txt',size:bytes.length,sha256:hash,destination:{kind:'artifact'},collision:{choice:'keep_both',name:'source (1).txt'},task_id:task.task_id},{label:'Upload reviewed source'});if(receipt.result?.kind!=='transfer')throw Error('Declaration rejected');const id=receipt.result.transfer.transfer_id;h.transfers=h.transfers.map(t=>t.transfer_id===id?{...t,transferred:bytes.length}:t);const done=await h.finishUpload(id,hash,'text/plain',bytes);if(!done.ok)throw Error(done.reason);const artifact=a.session.state.get().artifacts[done.artifactId];if(!artifact?.links?.some(l=>l.task_id===task.task_id&&l.role==='source'))throw Error('Missing Source link');a.ui.push({screen:'transfers'},'library')})()
